title: Ragtime pianists and Fess Hill
summary: Smith and Lovett note ragtime piano is a dying art and remember Fess Hill playing it.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: You know it's awfully hard to find a good ragtime pianist anymore. It's a dying art. Fess could play.
This old fellow that played the other night, what was his name, old piano player, ragtime piano player -- Blake.
-- there aren't that many around. Remember Fess -- Fess Hill, may God rest his soul .
Oh, we worked together for a long time.

course. I remember him doing "Three Nickel Rag" downstairs in the Bar and "Greasy Spoon Rag" but it's a dying art, it really is.
